body:
R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST: the architecture, CI shape and development shape at programme end, in words and mermaid figures, and the owner's Buy Me a Coffee button. Part of #2395 and #201 (R10-ARCH-DOCS, the round's last stage, verifies, adjusts and wiring-tests what this lands, and closes the issue).

This is the docs delivery the owner (tvofi, 2026-10-22) asked to have stamped right after it merges.

Built to the approved design note `dev/programme/designs/R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST.md` at f122a1cb5d6aea08bb57840721e646c87f3c51fd (revision 2, ref `design/r10-arch-docs-first`). Design verdicts: `handoff-body/design-verdict-r10-arch-docs-first` (`Design review: revise 16954f0c8 architecture-unsound`, revision 1) and `handoff-body/design-verdict-r10-arch-docs-first-r2` (`Design review: approve f122a1cb5d6aea08bb57840721e646c87f3c51fd`).

What it writes:
- `docs/architecture.md`: every `##` section on main is kept. "How the pieces fit" takes seed 4305cd109's four-region diagram (outside, the Home Assistant boundary, the pure core, the learners) and its legend, re-derived at the merge base. The counts stay the tree's own, and `tests/entities.py` and `tests/doc_claims.py` still check them. "Where the architecture is measured" names `tools/audit/archscore/` and the wiring check. New: "The shape at programme end", one marked line per code group that changes the shape.
- `dev/README.md` (new): the developer onboarding, from seed 0edd7fa66 with its literal counts replaced by commands. It covers the `dev/` layout, the governing documents, the work in order (audit → [design → design review, L/XL] → fix → fix review → train → merge → record → stamp), the requirements before a push and the CI shape, the orchestration machinery (carries a, b, c) and a command-generated index of `dev/audit/harnesses/` (the O9 fold).
- `README.md`: one developer paragraph pointing to `dev/README.md`, and the button at the top.
- The button: https://buymeacoffee.com/rpgshcwb2tp from three places: the top of `README.md` as an in-tree SVG, `docs/img/brand/coffee.svg`; `docs/index.html`'s own `<footer>`; and the shared footer `tools/site/build_docs.mjs` renders on every markdown page. On the site it is an inline SVG icon plus a `.bmc` rule in `var(--accent)`/`var(--accent-ink)`. The README's SVG carries docs.css's light and dark token values under `prefers-color-scheme`, and the test compares those values with `docs/site/docs.css`. Nothing comes from another origin.
- `tests/doc_claims.py`: `doc_wiring_findings` checks predicates (a)–(e) of the note's §6 over the three marked documents, and (e) over the note's sibling-site list; `coffee_button_findings` checks the three placements and the SVG's tokens. Red fixtures, the state-tolerance control and the null controls are inline.
- `tests/layout.py`: `PATH_TOKEN` and `repo_path`, the one definition of the repository-path-shaped token. Round 3 (decision O-5 item 1): predicate (a) and `tests/entities.py`'s `_sp_path_literal` both read it, so the grammar is written once instead of registered twice. `tests/layout.py` is the module owning the tree's path vocabulary (`canon`, `locate`), and `layout.py` imports only the standard library, where importing `entities.py` from `doc_claims.py` would have pulled its whole import graph in. `doc_wiring_findings` imports `repo_path` function-locally, the file's own idiom: a top-level import shifted every line below it, and `brief_lint.mjs` then refused `dev/programme/carries/carry-1645.json`'s citation `tests/doc_claims.py:476`.
- Classification: the `dev` category in `tests/layout.json`. `tests/closure.py` moves the roster and the SVG to `INERT_EXCEPT`, because doc_claims opens them. `tests/closures.json`'s doc_claims entry adds `tests/layout.py` (round 3's import).
- `dev/governance/config/corpus_excluded.json`: `dev/README.md`, reason "developer onboarding, not policy; it defers to CLAUDE.md" (decision O-5 item 2, the pre-approved fallback; `## Raise justification`).
- `dev/governance/dimensions/D9.md`: the stale `harnesses/README.md` citation now names `dev/audit/README.md`, the harness contract the sentence means (O-2's citation correction, kept by O-5 item 3).

Visual language (note §4): meaning is in shape. A seat is a stadium, a script or detached job is a rectangle, a decision is a rhombus, a ref or store is a cylinder, and a planned edge is dashed. No block carries a hex value or an `%%{init}`, and (e) refuses either.

Design choices the checks encode, stated so they are not read as bugs:
- (a) checks a backticked token as a repository path only when `repo_path` holds: it contains `/` and its first segment is a top-level tracked name. A span with a placeholder (`<`, `>`, `*`, `{`, `$`) is skipped, so `handoff/<topic>` passes as prose.
- A marker inside an inline-code span is the grammar being quoted and is not read as a marker.
- The marker's unit is a list item, a table row, a paragraph, or a heading that covers its section (note §3).
- (d) skips `|…|` and quoted edge labels, and a subgraph id counts as declared.

Hot files, for train accounting (the orchestrator owns the roster, item F2). Beyond the roster's `files` (`docs/architecture.md`, `README.md`): `tools/site/build_docs.mjs`, `docs/index.html`, `docs/site/docs.css`, `docs/img/brand/coffee.svg`, `dev/README.md`, `tests/doc_claims.py`, `tests/entities.py` (round 3: `_sp_path_literal` reads `repo_path`), `tests/layout.py` (round 3), `tests/layout.json`, `tests/closure.py`, `tests/closures.json`, `dev/governance/config/corpus_excluded.json` (round 3), `dev/governance/dimensions/D9.md`, `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mermaid_parse.mjs`, `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_first_mutants.py`. No longer touched (round 3, O-5): `tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs` and `tools/policy/agreement.mjs`, both byte-identical to `origin/main`.

Alternatives, and why each lost:
- Registering the path-token grammar in `agreement.mjs` `SHARED_GRAMMARS` (round 2): never runs on this PR, because decision 0013 restores `agreement.mjs` from the base; and a registered duplicate is still two definitions. Removing the duplication passes under either copy.
- `doc_claims.py` importing `_sp_path_literal` from `tests/entities.py`: pulls `heatpump_optimizer` and the HA stub into the doc check.
- The `policy_lint.mjs` `resolveCited` canon lookup in this PR (round 2): sound, and the real removal of the cause, but the base-pinned `policy-docs` and `env-matrix` lanes run main's copy and refuse at 246 pins. Split out to its own PR (Forward-carry).
- An inline README link `[![…](svg)](https://…)`: HACS's README image rewriter (pinned by `tests/entities.py`) leaves a relative image unrewritten when `://` follows it on the line.
- A hotlinked badge, a `<picture>` pair, a rename of `dev/README.md`, SVG figures, onboarding inside README, a separate CI-GATE file: as the note and round 1 list.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) (attribution placed here, not at the end, because `## Friction` must be the last section and every line in it must parse)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01QgprvyuvZydszQmGB7kMxT

## Head

`97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d` adds one commit on top of `ff83a3d7`, made by the orchestrator: the round-4 D6 claims files (`dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.json`, `claims.md`) re-recorded for this PR's README links and image (C108 81 -> 84, C110 21 -> 22). No other file changes, and the reviewed code is unchanged (Red checks).

`ff83a3d7d099d4b98fb1a972470f30854f79078f` merges main `4714748` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c` merges the authored code head `7ae69419ed16f95f70b6cca59fca9b15dd4b3fab` and then merges origin/main `543c8087c` (an automatic merge by the orchestrator's script; any resolution inside the code head is described below) into this PR's previous head, and then adds one commit containing only this PR's own row, `dev/programme/delivery/2609.md`.

7ae69419ed16f95f70b6cca59fca9b15dd4b3fab (round 3), on top of PR head a0520623a31dd50ca07e3a4067e42e32b3b13554 (code 122381f55 plus a merge of main 6c8903a44). Merge base 6c8903a44ca2, `origin/main` at 6c8903a44 when measured, 2026-10-22T11:30Z to 12:05Z; `git merge origin/main` was a no-op beyond a0520623's own merge. Round 3 is one commit: the path-token grammar defined once, the `corpus_excluded.json` entry, `policy_lint.mjs` and `agreement.mjs` reverted to main, and mutant M16 added to the harness.

## Mutation proof

Instrument: `python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_first_mutants.py <scratch worktree at 7ae69419e>`. It applies each mutant in place, runs `tests/doc_claims.py`, lists the FAIL lines, and restores the file. Every row targets the predicate, not a tail line. Run with `PATH=/opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin:$PATH`.

| mutant | rc | checks that go red |
|---|---|---|
| M0 null (no mutation) | 0 | none (null control) |
| M1 (a) path resolution never fires | 1 | red fixture: a renamed path is a finding |
| M2 (a) marker exemption dropped | 1 | three: every path resolves or is marked…; the clean fixture yields no finding…; state tolerance… |
| M3 (b) unknown group passes | 1 | red fixture: a marker naming no roster group is a finding |
| M4 (b) malformed marker passes | 1 | red fixture: a malformed marker is a finding |
| M5 (c) refuses a done group | 1 | state tolerance: a marker naming a done group… yield only notes |
| M6 N1 roster read unconditionally | 1 | no marker: no roster is read (null control, N1) |
| M7 (d) declared-node rule off | 1 | red fixture: a bare node id used once is a finding |
| M8 (d) diagram type unchecked | 1 | red fixture: a block of an unknown diagram type is a finding |
| M9 (d) sequence participants unchecked | 1 | red fixture: an undeclared sequence participant is a finding |
| M10 (e) hex colour unchecked | 1 | red fixture: a hex fill is a finding |
| M11 (e) init unchecked | 1 | red fixture: an init directive is a finding |
| M12–M15 button arms off (README, index footer, built footer, SVG token compare) | 1 each | the matching red case, one FAIL each |
| M16 (a) the shared `tests/layout.py` `repo_path` never matches (round 3) | 1 | red fixture: a renamed path is a finding |
| P1–P4 production: button gone from build_docs.mjs / index.html / README, a marker dropped from dev/README.md | 1 each | the button check (P1–P3), the wiring check (P4) |

17 + 4 rows, 0 `CRASH` lines (`grep -c CRASH` on the run's output).

## Null control

- M0 above: the unmutated head, 0 FAIL lines, rc 0.
- The grammar duplication (O-5 item 4's null): in the base-pinned scratch worktree, re-adding `_PATH_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[\w.-]+(?:/[\w.-]+)+/?")` to `tests/doc_claims.py` and running the agreement lane prints `UNREGISTERED "[\\w.-]+(?:/[\\w.-]+)+/?" in tests/doc_claims.py, tests/entities.py`, `RESULT divergent=0 unregistered=1`, `AGREEMENT REFUSED`, rc 1: CI's wave-script line at a0520623 returns. Restored: `AGREEMENT ok`.
- The exclusion's null: in the same worktree, removing `dev/README.md` from `corpus_excluded.json` and running main's `node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs` prints `ERROR [named-docs] dev/README.md: is named by .claude/rules/ratchet-budgets.md but has no cap`, `TOTAL: 1 error(s)`: CI's policy-docs line at a0520623. Restored: `TOTAL: 0`.
- The checker's own controls in `tests/doc_claims.py`: the clean fixture yields no finding and no note; the state-tolerance control yields two notes and no finding; with no marker, no roster is read; a marker with no roster file is a finding.
- The mermaid parse: a planted broken block makes the driver exit 1 (round 1's control; the driver is unchanged).

## Figures

The base-pinned lane, reproduced locally (O-5 item 4). Commands, in a scratch worktree at 7ae69419e:
- `git diff --name-only -z "$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)" origin/main -- <wave-script's pinned pathspec list, copied from .github/workflows/governance.yml>` then `git checkout origin/main --pathspec-from-file=<list> --pathspec-file-nul`: restored `tests/entities.py` and `tests/layout.py` (every other pinned file is already identical to main), then committed as CI does. The policy-docs list is a subset of that one.
- `node tools/policy/check-wave-script.mjs`: `202 passed, 0 failed`.
- `python3 -I tools/policy/agreement_py.py --out <json>` then `node tools/policy/agreement.mjs --py-json <json>`: `agreement_py restore: 13 closure file(s), 13 covered by the wave-script restore list, 0 missing`; `RESULT divergent=0 unregistered=0 dead=0 refused=0`, `AGREEMENT ok`.
- `node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs`: `TOTAL: 0 error(s) across 43 policy file(s)`, `FIXTURE ok: 92 error(s) hold 246 pins`.
- `node tools/policy/policy_lint_envmatrix.mjs "$PWD" <out> "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`, the head's driver as the env-matrix job runs it: `16 declared outcome(s) held, 0 did not, across 6 environment shape(s)`, rc 0, `pr / policy_lint rc=0 and every pin earned` ok. Measured at 7ae69419e. Null: the CI run at a0520623 (job 119791595403), `rc=1 pins=246`.

At the head, unpinned:
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/doc_claims.py` (venv-ci python 3.14): `ALL 203 checks PASSED`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/entities.py`: `ALL 2388 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED`, rc 0, the D11-05 template arm (which runs the whole policy lint) and the HACS README image rule included. Measured on b5ff470b5's tree and not re-run at 7ae69419e, which differs only in where `tests/doc_claims.py` imports `repo_path` and in mutant M16; CI's full suite runs it at the head.
- `python3 tests/structure.py`: `STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/layout.py`: `layout self-test: ok`.
- `node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs`: `TOTAL: 0 error(s)`, `246 pins` (the same program as main's: `git diff --quiet origin/main HEAD -- tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs tools/policy/agreement.mjs` exits 0).
- The head's agreement lane: `RESULT divergent=0 unregistered=0 dead=0 refused=0`, `AGREEMENT ok`.
- `grep -rnF '[\w.-]+(?:/[\w.-]+)+/?' tests tools`: one line, `tests/layout.py` (`PATH_TOKEN`). Null: at a0520623 the same grep returns `tests/entities.py` and `tests/doc_claims.py` (`agreement.mjs`'s registration spells it JS-escaped, which `-F` does not match).
- `NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mermaid_parse.mjs <scratch copy of tools/site after npm ci> docs/architecture.md dev/README.md README.md`: `mermaid 12.1.0 parse+render in Chromium: 8 block(s), 0 failure(s)`.
- `node tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs --check`: `RULES-SYNC ok`.
- `node tests/md_tables.mjs`: `doc_swallowed_prose_lines=0`, `doc_orphaned_table_rows=0`, `doc_misrendered_lines=0`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/pr/ci_predict.py --base origin/main`: `CI PREDICT: no closures or fast red predicted against 6c8903a44ca2`.
- Scope, `python3 tests/closure.py select --diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) --workdir D`: `MODE: FULL`, reason `tests/closure.py changes the gate itself, so every closure is suspect`. CI runs the full suite; locally the scripts above (fixer.md step 5).
- `PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 bash tools/pr/prepr.sh <this body>` at 7ae69419e: every lane ok or skip (`closures` skipped by the variable; `push order` and `ancestry reds` skipped, no remote branch for this worktree). Null: its run at f893146ca refused `brief_lint` (the shifted carry citation above) and `pr-body` (a carry naming a file not in the tree).
- Claims and version: `git diff --quiet $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD -- tests/golden/claimed_drift.txt tests/golden/card_claimed_drift.txt VERSION RELEASE_NOTES.md` exits 0. The branch claims nothing.

## Architecture score

`python3 tools/audit/archscore/score.py --diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)`: before (a0520623) `Architecture score: dS +0.0000 NULL`; after (7ae69419e) `Architecture score: dS +0.0000 NULL`. No production module is touched.

## Raise justification

No `*_budgets.json` changes. The one cap-shaped change is the `corpus_excluded.json` entry for `dev/README.md`, decision O-5 item 2 (orchestrator, under mandate 6329234399, scope all), the pre-approved fallback.
- Payment 2 tried (round 2): correct the cause. `policy_lint.mjs` `resolveCited` looks a token up by `canon(token)` before the basename fallback, so the correct citation `dev/audit/README.md` (canon `tools/audit/README.md`) stops naming every tracked `README.md`; plus the D9.md citation correction. Locally clean at 247 pins. Refused on CI at a0520623, policy-docs job 119791595301: `[named-docs] dev/README.md: is named by .claude/rules/ratchet-budgets.md but has no cap ...`; env-matrix job 119791595403: `pr / policy_lint rc=0 and every pin earned -- rc=1 pins=246`.
- Why it cannot land in this PR: `.github/workflows/governance.yml`'s step "Restore the check source from the base commit" (decision 0013) checks `tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs` out from the base before grading, so a PR cannot change its own checker. The canon lookup goes forward as its own PR (Forward-carry), after which the entry is dropped.
- Payment 1 taken: the entry, reason "developer onboarding, not policy; it defers to CLAUDE.md", also in the commit message.
- Architecture score: dS +0.0000 (before a0520623 and after 7ae69419e, `tools/audit/archscore/score.py --diff`).

## Unpinned sites

none: the diff adds no production code. `repo_path` is pinned by mutant M16.

## Red checks

At a0520623, all one cause: decision 0013's base-pinned checker. The PR changed `tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs` and `tools/policy/agreement.mjs`, and the pinned lanes graded it with main's copies.
- `policy-docs` (job 119791595301): `[named-docs] dev/README.md`. Answered: payment 1, the `corpus_excluded.json` entry.
- `env-matrix` (job 119791595403): `pr / policy_lint rc=0 and every pin earned -- rc=1 pins=246`, and the push-main and no-remote arms. Answered: the 247th pin is split out with the canon lookup.
- `wave-script` (job 119791595043): `UNREGISTERED "[\\w.-]+(?:/[\\w.-]+)+/?" in tests/doc_claims.py, tests/entities.py`, `AGREEMENT REFUSED`. Answered: the grammar is defined once, in `tests/layout.py`.
- `pr-contract`: `## Red checks` did not name wave-script; follows from the above, answered by this section.
- Cheaper detector: running the base-pinned lane locally before the push (restore the pinned list from `origin/main`, then the lint, the agreement lane and the env-matrix driver), as Figures does. `tools/pr/prepr.sh` does not: its steps 3e–3g run the HEAD's copy of each pinned grader, to predict main's push verdict, and it names `policy_lint_envmatrix.mjs` in `PINNED_ELSEWHERE`. Standing cost here: the lint and agreement lane in seconds, the env-matrix driver in minutes. Carry: R10-ORCH-MACHINERY (prepr runs each pinned grader under the base's copy too when the diff touches a pinned path).

At c00082a9, one cause, the body itself:
- `pr-contract` (jobs 119812987030 and 119813184314): `CARRY-AUDIT: 17 finding item(s): 16 routed, 1 unrouted`. The Forward-carry section's closing destinations line was a bullet, so carry_audit read it as a finding with no destination. Answered: that line is now prose; the code head is unchanged. Cheaper detector: `python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py check --body <body>` before the body push, about 0.1 s. Carry: dismissed: resolved by this body edit; no remaining work.

At ff83a3d7 (the merge train's recarry of c00082a9), one cause, this PR's own README change:
- `fast (3.14)` (check-run 119826108493): `FAIL the executed harnesses leave their committed output byte-identical [uncommitted: M dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.json; M dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.md]`. `dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.py` counts the relative links (C108) and embedded images (C110) in README.md and docs/*.md, and the coffee button and developer links moved them from 81 to 84 and from 21 to 22. Answered: commit 97ac438d6 re-records both files; only C108 and C110 move, and `tests/harness_headers.py` prints `ALL 109 HARNESS HEADER CHECKS PASSED`. Cheaper detector: `python3 tests/harness_headers.py` before the push, a couple of minutes; it is in the fast lane this PR's closure reaches, and the fixer seats ran prepr with PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Carry: R10-PREPR-UNPINNED-RED (a docs PR that edits README.md or docs/*.md runs the D6 claims harness in prepr even with closures skipped).

## Forward-carry

- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS. Land `policy_lint.mjs` `resolveCited` canon lookup + its pin as its own PR (decision 0013 pins the checker from base), then drop `dev/README.md`'s `corpus_excluded.json` entry. The round-2 patch is commit 122381f55 (`tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs`, one lookup line plus one acceptance pin).
- Carry: R10-ORCH-MACHINERY. `tools/pr/prepr.sh` runs the head's copy of each pinned grader but never the base's, so a PR that changes its own checker reaches CI unpredicted (Red checks).
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item R1). Own the end-of-round predicate "no target or retired-by marker names a done group"; here (c) is report-only (§3).
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item T1). Wire a real `mermaid.parse` into a check; `dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mermaid_parse.mjs` needs a DOM (Chromium).
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item V1). Add the docs.css token map in `tools/site/build_docs.mjs` to mermaid's `themeVariables`.
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item V2). Confirm light and dark on both renderers.
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item S1). Widen (e) tree-wide if it chooses; today it covers `MERMAID_STYLE_DOCS`.
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item D1). Check the machinery figure against R10-ORCH-MACHINERY's job and event-kind tables at its own merge base.
- Carry: R10-ARCH-DOCS (item F1). Fold P40 there: compare the `docs/img/card/*.png` figures to the card.
- Carry: R10-PLAN-ARTIFACT (item D2). One plan model, marked `[target: R10-PLAN-ARTIFACT]`.
- Carry: R10-ROUND-PLAYBOOK (item D3). Its path-resolving control is `doc_wiring_findings`: extend it rather than building a second checker.
- Carry: R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 (item D4). The ruleset node, `.github/workflows/pr-contract-rerun.yml` and `.github/workflows/budget-raise-gate-rerun.yml` are marked for that group.
- decision: orchestrator. Carry: R10-FLOW-BOARD (item D5). The same notice goes to R10-REPLAY-SCOPED.
The orchestrator lands each of these in the named group's roster carries (finding-propagation.md).

## Approval

Owner approval is owed for two policy-bound files. `dev/governance/dimensions/D9.md` (one citation corrected): approved by the orchestrator under mandate 6329234399 (scope all), decision O-2, a citation correction, outside moratorium 0012. `dev/governance/config/corpus_excluded.json` (one entry): approved under the same mandate, decision O-5 item 2, the pre-approved fallback (`## Raise justification`). `tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs` and `tools/policy/agreement.mjs` are no longer changed. No budget file changes.

## Friction

- environment: stale: the payload says the venv is on PATH, but `python3` here is the system 3.11 interpreter without voluptuous; every run used `PATH=/opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin:$PATH`. Carry: dismissed: environment, not repository
- fixer.md#5: unclear: fixer.md says to run what scope.run names, and prepr.sh runs pinned graders at the head's copy, but neither says to run them at the base's copy, which is the verdict a PR's own CI gives. Carry: R10-ORCH-MACHINERY
- fixer.md#7: unclear: the roster lists #2395 under `fixes` for both this group and R10-ARCH-DOCS; this body says "Part of #2395". Carry: dismissed: orchestrator decides the closing keyword

Fix review: merge c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c bus-nonce: 41dfaf10948eb8633b0941d53f4a84b3 ## Scope PR #2609, group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST, fixer round 3 (code 7ae69419e, head c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c). Reviewed adversarially from detached worktrees at the head, base origin/main 543c8087c57973ee58033a0c62520b5ec3a58621. I checked the head again just before writing this verdict: the branch and the PR still point at c00082a9a. `dev/governance/roles/` is identical between the merge base and origin/main, so the contract I followed is the current one. ## Findings - pr-contract is red at this head, in both runs (jobs 119812987030 and 119813184314), and only because of the body. `tools/audit/carry_audit.py check` reads the `## Forward-carry` bullet `- Destinations: the orchestrator lands these in the named groups' roster carries (finding-propagation.md).` as a finding item with no destination. It prints `CARRY-AUDIT: 17 finding item(s): 16 routed, 1 unrouted`, rc 1. The body's `## Red checks` does not answer this red. Fix: rewrite that line as plain prose rather than a bullet, or end it with a `Carry:`. A body-only edit, so the head does not move. I reproduced the failure on the live body, and the same body with the line as prose prints `16 routed, 0 unrouted`, rc 0 (ev/carry-audit.txt). The code is unaffected. Owed before the merge train takes the PR.
